metadata.summary: Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane has not been named in the FIFPRO World 11.
metadata.content: FIFPRO World 11: Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane not voted by fellow professionals to be named in team of the year | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content FIFPRO World 11: Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane not voted by fellow professionals to be named in team of the year Harry Kane becomes the first Ballon d'Or winner to not be named in the FIFPRO World 11 after claiming the award; England team-mate Jude Bellingham is included; seven WSL stars have made the Women's FIFPRO World 11 Callum Bishop Football Journalist Monday 9 November 2026 17:15, UK Image: England captain Harry Kane was not named in the FIFPRO World 11 despite winning the Ballon d'Or Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane has not been named in the FIFPRO World 11. Over 18,000 professional footballers have chosen their best men's team, with the final 11 being chosen from a group of 26 selected finalists. Kane, who won the Ballon d'Or ahead of Real Madrid's Kylian Mbappe by one of the smallest margins in history, was among the 26 finalists but did not make the final team. Mbappe, Manchester City's Erling Haaland, Barcelona's Lamine Yamal and Inter Miami's Lionel Messi were named in a Kane-less front four, which also excluded Cristiano Ronaldo and Michael Olise. metadata.content: Lando Norris says McLaren are still not at the level to fight for world championship in 2027 despite Sao Paulo Grand Prix win | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Lando Norris says McLaren are still not at the level to fight for world championship in 2027 despite Sao Paulo Grand Prix win Lando Norris won a rain-affected Sao Paulo Grand Prix by nearly 15 seconds but he feels McLaren still have work to do ahead of 2027 to fight for the world title again; watch every session of the Las Vegas Grand Prix from November 20-22, live on Sky Sports F1 Nigel Chiu Sports Journalist @NigelCJourno Monday 9 November 2026 13:07, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Craig Slater gives his verdict on a wet Sao Paulo GP, where Lando Norris won, Max Verstappen fought from the back and Mercedes secured the constructors' title Lando Norris believes McLaren are "not at the level to fight for a world championship" despite his dominant win in mixed conditions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix. Norris converted pole position into victory for the third time this season as McLaren's upgrades in Brazil, including new wings and floor components, gave them immediate performance. messages.text: Fleming turns to uncapped spinner amid big calls for first Test series as England coach

metadata.summary: England have called up uncapped left-arm finger spinner Liam Patterson-White for this winter's three-Test series in South Africa, while Shoaib Bashir has dropped down to the Lions squad.
metadata.content: England Test squad for South Africa: Uncapped spinner Liam Patterson-White called up and Jacob Bethell returns | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content England Test squad for South Africa: Uncapped spinner Liam Patterson-White called up and Jacob Bethell returns England selectors name a 15-player squad for the three-Test series away to South Africa with uncapped spinner Liam Patterson-White earning a call-up; Shoaib Bashir dropped to Lions squad; Jacob Bethell returns to the Test squad following his knee injury during the summer Monday 9 November 2026 13:31, UK England have called up uncapped left-arm finger spinner Liam Patterson-White for this winter's three-Test series in South Africa, while Shoaib Bashir has dropped down to the Lions squad. All-rounder Patterson-White helped Nottinghamshire win the Championship title in 2025 by taking 26 wickets and scoring 540 runs in 11 appearances, and then claimed 42 wickets and scored 474 runs in 14 appearances last season. Jacob Bethell did not feature in August and September's 3-0 sweep of Pakistan due to a knee problem that required surgery, but he is back to add to England's batting options for a tour that is live in full on Sky Sports across December and January in what will be Stephen Fleming's first series as head coach. messages.text: England pave way for Carse return

metadata.summary: England have left the door open for Brydon Carse to return to the Test side after the fast bowler was called up to the 15-man Lions squad for their tour of South Africa.
metadata.content: Brydon Carse: England pave way for fast bowler's Test return ahead of South Africa series and will continue to 'invest' in Shoaib Bashir | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Brydon Carse: England pave way for fast bowler's Test return ahead of South Africa series and will continue to 'invest' in Shoaib Bashir Brydon Carse was included in England Lions' 15-man squad for their upcoming tour of South Africa and could be in line for a Test return; spinner Shoaib Bashir drops out of senior red ball squad; watch England's three-Test series vs South Africa live on Sky Sports Monday 9 November 2026 17:29, UK Image: Brydon Carse could return to play for England during their Test series against South Africa England have left the door open for Brydon Carse to return to the Test side after the fast bowler was called up to the 15-man Lions squad for their tour of South Africa. The 31-year-old was dropped from the Test squad midway through their summer series against Pakistan after he was arrested and later 'de-arrested' following an incident outside a Derby nightclub in August . Derbyshire police ended their investigation into the incident in September, but Carse was later charged by the Cricket Regulator and is yet to learn his fate.
